observations.basis: Independent observation of the original 644x216 PNG at open ordinal 1; not copied from author assertions.
sourceFacts: One unframed horizontal circuit section with an external wire continuing on each side.
Three filled unlettered dots lie on the conductor: before the left resistor, between the two resistors and after the right resistor.
Two hollow rectangular resistor symbols interrupt the conductor. R1 is left and R2 is right; each label is above its own rectangle.

The physical wires are the left external stub, left dot to R1 left face, R1 right face to middle dot, middle dot to R2 left face, R2 right face to right dot and right external stub. Neither rectangle has a wire through its interior or a bypass.
A single short current arrow above the middle conductor points right and is labelled I.

Below the conductor, V1 compares the left and middle dots, while V2 compares the middle and right dots. Each horizontal comparison has a leftward and a rightward head; two opposing heads meet at the middle comparison boundary.
Three vertical extension strokes project the left, middle and right dots to the lower comparisons. These are voltage-scope annotations, not additional conductive wires.
The complete instructional label set is R1, R2, I, V1 and V2. There are no numerical givens, node letters, total-V comparison, meters, battery, switch, extra panel or additional resistor.

No new numeric value, equation or answer is drawn.
